text:
maya: heads up — seeing sustained nvme iops spike on ephemeral drives during nightly janitor window (eu-west2). GPU attach latency jumped, attach queue ~120 -> 330 over ~10m. logs:
```
[gnode-492] nvme0n1: io 98% util, svc 24ms, write amplification high
attach queue: 330 pending, avg wait 210s
Janitor loop: running scrub on 12 nodes concurrently
```
ashwin: yikes. is this scrub pattern new? did scrub concurrency change in rollout?
maya: scrub concurrency unchanged, but scrub sampler rate increased last week for hotstripe mitigation; correlated with firmware update kube-label change.
liam: temporary mitigation: drop scrub concurrency to 2 in eu-west2 and lower io-weight to 30% for janitor. Can someone patch the ds?
ashwin: I'll patch now. command:
```
kubectl -n infra patch daemonset ephemeral-janitor --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"janitor","env":[{"name":"SCRUB_CONCURRENCY","value":"2"},{"name":"IO_WEIGHT","value":"30"}] }]}}}}'
```
liam: +1, also set rolloutStrategy to maxUnavailable 50% to avoid mass concurrent scrub.
sophia: small reminder: reducing scrub speed increases time-to-clean, could push up storage tail latency later and slightly bump cost due to longer KV cache retention. tradeoff ok for 12-24h.
maya: agreed — do this as canary for eu-west2 only, and monitor GPU attach SLOs
ops-bot: alert configured: gpu-attach-queue > 200 in eu-west2 -> paging oncall
ashwin: canary patched; rolling restart starting on 3 nodes.
deploy-bot: rollout success: ephemeral-janitor patched on nodes 3/3 (eu-west2-canary)
liam: watching metrics dashboard — attach queue falling to ~80 within 4m. nice.
sophia: schedule a follow-up to evaluate wear telemetry — want to confirm we didn't regress SMART growth rates with slowed scrubs.
maya: creating a short postmortem note and cost estimate. will add action items: (1) make scrub concurrency region-aware, (2) add backoff on scrub when gpu-attach > threshold, (3) add canary rollout in deploy pipeline.
ashwin: also add small ramp-down for scrub after firmware or kernel upgrades for 48h.
maya: thanks team. I'll close once metrics stable for 6h. :thumbsup:
